summary.overview: The CWR-CE engine has strong reproducible build tooling and an FFI-ABI mechanical gate, but a critical water-system diff ships with no focused C++ behavioral test, a wgpu path that is compile-only in CI, and a project-mandated smoke that overwrites the Steam install with manual backup-only rollback. Session evidence is unavailable, so learning-capture opportunities cannot be observed in this window.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: CLAUDE.md gives solid general routing to build/test/lint/architecture, but there is no scoped AGENTS.md for the 1155-file Poseidon tree or the WgpuRenderer, and the water-system plan is not linked from the root entrypoint.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: CMake presets, vcpkg triplets, Build.ps1, and Docker give a reproducible, exercised startup; the gap is a side-effect boundary where the standing smoke overwrites the Steam install.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: A broad Catch2 suite and CI run ctest, but the changed C++ water-freeze path has no focused test, the wgpu path is compile-only in CI, and clang-tidy is not CI-enforced; only the FFI static_assert and one Rust contract test cover the diff.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: The diff ships a thorough acceptance report and CI gates PRs, but it is uncommitted, the smoke recovery is a manual file copy, and branch protection is unobserved.

findings.title: The changed C++ water-freeze path has no focused automated test
findings.reason: The critical WTR-001 diff modifies WaterSettings::Freeze, the freeze substitution and UBO-digest log in WaterWgpu::DrawWater, the WgrWaterFreezeBits FFI enum, and the DebugOverlay Water tab. A grep across tests/**/*.cpp for WaterSettings, WaterWgpu, WgrWater, freezeFft, and cameraPathFrame returns zero relevant matches; the only 'freeze' hits are unrelated gameplay, download-worker, and lip-sync tests. The acceptance report's C++ evidence is 'verified by inspection' plus a manual --check init-and-exit that initializes the wgpu renderer but renders no frame, so the freeze substitution and digest log are never exercised. A regression in a bit-cast lane, a missed clock path, or a broken digest would not be caught by the suite; the determinism claim rests on reasoning and one Rust bit-cast contract test.
expectedOutput: A ctest-runnable test that exercises the water-freeze substitution and confirms the UBO digest is stable across two frozen frames.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add the smallest focused Catch2 test that exercises the changed C++ water-freeze path, keeping the existing FFI static_assert and Rust contract test intact.

## Scope
- Cover WaterSettings::Freeze and the freeze substitution in WaterWgpu::DrawWater, including the UBO-digest path.
- Place the test under tests/unit/engine/ next to the existing water surface query test.

## Validation
- Build with `cmake --build build/<preset> --target PoseidonTests`
- Run `ctest --test-dir build/<preset> -R "<water-freeze>"` and confirm the new test passes
- Confirm the test fails when the freeze substitution is reverted

findings.title: The wgpu water path is compile-only in CI
findings.reason: build.yml sets TRIDENT_RENDER: gl33 and the trident-test job runs `tri test --render gl33`; ctest has no wgpu-water test. The wgpu renderer, the backend this diff changes, is compiled by the build jobs but never behaviorally exercised in CI. A wgpu-only behavioral regression can therefore merge green.
expectedOutput: A CI step that runs a wgpu-render behavioral check so wgpu-only regressions are caught before merge.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add a CI behavioral check for the wgpu render path, mirroring the existing gl33 trident-test job.

## Scope
- Add a job or matrix entry in .github/workflows/build.yml that runs a wgpu behavioral check (e.g., `tri test --render wgpu` against the demo data, or a headless `--check --render=wgpu` that renders at least one frame).
- Reuse the existing build-cwr action and demo-assets download.

## Validation
- Confirm the new CI job runs the wgpu path behaviorally on a PR
- Confirm it fails when the WaterWgpu freeze substitution is broken

findings.title: The accepted smoke overwrites the Steam install with manual backup-only rollback
findings.reason: The wtr-001-report.md documents a 'standing instruction' to overwrite the Steam install: it copies the fork PoseidonGame.exe over ColdWarAssault.exe and wgpu_renderer.dll in the Steam library, relying on *.stock.bak sidecar backups. The verification is an init-and-exit --check --render=wgpu (no frame render), and rollback is a manual CopyItem. There is no dry-run, sandbox, or isolated target for the destructive side effect.
expectedOutput: A non-destructive smoke that renders a water frame against isolated game data, with an owned rollback that does not depend on manual file copies.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Replace the destructive Steam-install-overwrite smoke with a sandboxed, non-destructive verification that has an owned rollback.

## Scope
- Point --render=wgpu at an isolated game-data directory (or run under the docker/steamrt4 container) so the Steam install is never overwritten.
- Render at least one water frame so the freeze substitution and digest log are exercised, not just init.
- Document the owned rollback postcondition.

## Validation
- Confirm the smoke runs without overwriting ColdWarAssault.exe or wgpu_renderer.dll
- Confirm a water frame renders and the rollback postcondition is recorded

findings.title: No scoped agent guidance routes work in the hot core areas

findings.title: clang-tidy is configured but not enforced in CI
findings.reason: The project ships .clang-tidy and Tidy/TidyFix CMake targets, declaring an intent to statically analyze C++, but lint.yml runs only clang-format --dry-run --Werror. This critical diff touches hot files (EngineWgpu.cpp, DebugOverlay.cpp) that approach the FileSize warn threshold, yet they are format-checked but not statically analyzed before merge.
expectedOutput: A scoped clang-tidy CI step on changed C++ files that complements the clang-format gate.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add a scoped clang-tidy step to the CI lint workflow, complementing the existing clang-format gate.

## Scope
- Add a step to .github/workflows/lint.yml that runs clang-tidy on changed C++ files (using the existing Tidy CMake target or run-clang-tidy over the git diff file list), consistent with the project .clang-tidy config.
- Keep the documented exclusion list so legacy files are not blocked.

## Validation
- Confirm lint.yml runs clang-tidy on a PR
- Confirm the existing Format gate still passes
